test "$(realpath "$root")" = /home/gace/Project/Gserver/projects/TGtumbler/GateApp-Bot || exit 70

from pathlib import Path
import subprocess,sys,tempfile
root,stage=map(Path,sys.argv[1:])
paths=["scripts/userbot_resident_ipc.py","scripts/userbot_room_smoke.py","scripts/userbot_test_client.py"]
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
  for i,p in enumerate(paths):
    base=subprocess.run(["git","-C",str(root),"show","HEAD:"+p],capture_output=True,check=True).stdout
    local=(root/p).read_bytes()
    remote=(stage/p).read_bytes()
    files=[]
    for j,data in enumerate((local,base,remote)):
      f=Path(tmp)/f"{i}-{j}.py"
      f.write_bytes(data)
      files.append(str(f))
    out=subprocess.run(["git","merge-file","-p",*files],capture_output=True)
    if out.returncode!=0:
      print("MERGE_CONFLICT_INDEX="+str(i))
      sys.exit(80+i)
    if b"<<<<<<<" in out.stdout:
      sys.exit(83+i)
    print("MERGE_CLEAN_INDEX="+str(i)+",LOCAL_CHANGED="+str(local!=base)+",OUTPUT_BYTES="+str(len(out.stdout)))
print("THREE_WAY_MERGE_PREFLIGHT_PASS")
PY
